title: DECISION: Extracted handle_key as pure testable function
description:
What: handle_key(state, code, modifiers) is a synchronous function that mutates state in place, extracted from the event loop.

Why it's good: Enables comprehensive unit testing of keyboard logic (Up/Down/Tab/Char/Backspace/Cursor/Scroll) without a real terminal or EventStream. Tests exercise all keybinding paths independently. The function is deterministic and side-effect-free (only mutates passed-in state), making test setup trivial.
